title: Threshold and Below-Threshold Dynamics for the Energy-Critical NLS: The Higher-Kinetic-Energy Regime
summary: We study the focusing energy-critical nonlinear Schrödinger equation below and at the ground-state energy, focusing on solutions in the upper energy cone, characterized by \[ E(u)\le E(W),\qquad \|\nabla u\|_{L_x^2}>\|\nabla W\|_{L_x^2}, \] where \(W\) is the ground state. Unlike the lower cone, where compactness of critical solutions plays a central role in understanding the dynamics, such compactness is generally unavailable on the upper branch.
